description: AGSC-01-40 (b): two paths under content/assets/ that are equal after NFC and Unicode simple case folding collide on a case-insensitive file system, and the warning AGSC-E423 is reported on each path of the group except the first in code-point order. Derivation: content/assets/Photo.txt and content/assets/photo.txt fold to one name; capital P sorts before small p, so Photo.txt is first and the one warning names content/assets/photo.txt. The minimal fixture's lint reports nothing and neither file is a fault of any other rule. Exit 0.
